title: Microbatch rolling tally — personal run tracker
content:
Table: quick rolling tally for small-batch runs (personal).
Columns: run_id | date | time | model_variant | batch_size | avg_seq | tokens_total | p50_ms | p95_ms | cpu_gpu | est_cost_usd | notes

R001 | 2024-11-05 | 09:12 | redwood-7b-q4f | 4 | 128 | 2048 | 42 | 110 | g4dn.xlarge | 0.013 | warm start, steady KV hit ~0.6
R002 | 2024-11-05 | 09:27 | redwood-7b-q4f | 8 | 64 | 2048 | 55 | 160 | g4dn.xlarge | 0.018 | batching helps, tail latency worse
R003 | 2024-11-05 | 10:05 | redwood-13b-int8 | 2 | 256 | 512 | 90 | 240 | p3.2xlarge | 0.045 | memory pressure, consider kv-sharding
R004 | 2024-11-06 | 14:03 | redwood-7b-q4f | 16 | 32 | 512 | 70 | 190 | g4dn.xlarge | 0.022 | small seq, higher throughput but big p95 spikes
R005 | 2024-11-07 | 11:40 | redwood-7b-q4f | 4 | 512 | 2048 | 120 | 320 | g4dn.xlarge | 0.021 | long prefixes cause cache misses, retry prob ~0.02
R006 | 2024-11-09 | 16:21 | redwood-7b-q4f + prefix-cache | 4 | 512 | 2048 | 68 | 150 | g4dn.xlarge | 0.015 | prefix cache enabled -> p50 down 43%, p95 down 53%
R007 | 2024-11-10 | 08:05 | redwood-7b-q4f | 1 | 1024 | 1024 | 180 | 420 | g4dn.xlarge | 0.012 | single-request long context, expensive tail

Quick summary (personal):
- Small batches (4–8) with prefix caching give best balance of latency & cost for chat-like flows.
- Larger batch sizes give throughput wins but exacerbate p95 unless strict admission control.
- Int8/quantized 13b moves p50 up but p95s balloon due to mem swaps on older instances.
- Prefix/KV cache is the highest ROI change for my workload: cuts both median and tail.

Notes to self (short):
- R006 felt like the most production-feasible config so far. Confirm stability across 24h sample.
- Add a quick synthetic that simulates 30% cache hit / 70% miss to validate fallback.
- Try android-like short-turn conversations (avg seq 40) with batching=8 to see cost slope.
- Watch for GC/memory churn on p3; collect dmesg + nvml snapshots next run.

Next steps / action items:
- [ ] Schedule 24h R006 stability run (script: experiments/run_stability.sh, branch: linked PR).
- [ ] Add a tiny eval set (10 transcripts) to measure quality delta when enabling kv-cache prefetch.
- [ ] Open a short bug if p95 > 200ms for batch_size<=8 across 3 runs (tag: latency-investigation).

Scratchpad: quick heuristics and thresholds
- Acceptable p50 <= 80ms for interactive flows.
- p95 target <= 200ms for SLAs in demo env.
- If cost per 1k tokens > $0.03 on g4dn for normal chat, flag for quantization or smaller model.

Random observations / fragment notes:
- "sometimes the first token is sweaty" = first-token expensive when model warms and KV not primed. Document run_id when observed.
- For multi-tenant experiment push, make test header include tenant id header x-tenant-sim.

Reference lines (quick):
- experiment script: /home/kiran/experiments/microbatch/runner_v2.sh
- perf dashboard (temp): https://grafana.internal/redwood/microbatch-kiran

End of page — short running log. Keep this as my quick go-to when iterating configs.
